esg_purpose.title: Environmental Sustainability
esg_purpose.content1: We are committed to using ECOCERT certified organic ingredients, and strictly refuse animal testing and the addition of parabens.
esg_purpose.content2: At VÖODÖOMÖI, we believe beauty should be enduringly sustainable. We select FSC-certified recyclable packaging materials and strive to minimize single-use plastics and reduce our carbon footprint.

slogan.title: VÖODÖOMÖI | Fragrance | Skin
slogan.content1: Born from the lyrical rhythm of old French — Vœu de Moi, a wish whispered to oneself — VÖODÖOMÖI is a quiet invocation of beauty.
slogan.content2: It invites you to journey beyond solitude, to awaken what lies dormant beneath skin and sentiment — a beauty entirely your own.

brand_story.title: BRAND STORY
brand_story.content: Conjured from VŒU DE MOI, the ultimate wish for self-fulfillment and self-love, VÖODÖOMÖI offers skin and body care solutions. The founder, Dr. Joseph Wan, believes in the neuro-sensory benefits of fragrance to mind and body, and crafts the full array of organic and fragrant skin and home products. His expertise in functional imaging and respiratory diseases enable him to explore the potentials of the liaison in between olfaction and holistic wellness.
